title: Vijayanagar Economy
definition: A highly monetized, agrarian-based economy characterized by the Nayankara system, extensive maritime trade, and a sophisticated taxation structure that facilitated the empire's role as a global commercial hub.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding administrative terminology (Nayankara, Ayagar) and in Mains for understanding medieval state formation and trade-urbanization linkages.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vijayanagar Economy.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Medieval Indian History
Understanding of Feudalism vs. Centralized Administration
